description: Browse and compare the public ABIS interior style and room catalogs. Also returns the existing optional website preparation guide for compatibility. For creating a personalized visual proposal from the user's photo or floor plan, use start_interior_design.

needs.description: At most three concerns explicitly stated by the user. Catalog IDs only; never send a photo, personal details or a raw conversation.

room.description: Room selected by the user; auto when unspecified. Do not guess from a private photo.

source.description: Known client: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.
